notes.subject: במפגיע
notes.rationale: Major crux: 'that it strike the mark' (JPS/ASV) vs KJV 'the cloud that cometh betwixt' vs Geneva 'against it' — the hitpael participle is genuinely obscure.

notes.subject: על כפים כסה אור
notes.rationale: 'He covers lightning with/on palms': ASV/JPS 'covers His hands with lightning' vs KJV 'covers the light with clouds' — same consonants, opposite direction.

notes.subject: כסה
notes.rationale: 'Cover' repeats from v.30 (roots of the sea), binding lightning and sea under one verb.

translation: Long tupela han em i karamapim ⟨את⟩ lait, na i givim olget long em long poinim mak.
